heading: Quick start
intro: From a checkout today. After the first PyPI release, install with `pipx install grounded` or run one-off commands with `uvx grounded`.
steps: Add one durable project fact: a domain term, business rule, architecture decision, workflow, or verification command.
Run `uv run grounded validate`, `uv run grounded render --check`, and `uv run grounded audit`.
